argument_markdown:
Source-backed input. By ATT-0120, claims CLM-0120-2 through CLM-0120-5, confirmed by REV-0169 and REV-0170, Y is the reduced Zariski closure of the geometric classifying image and

T_Z = ker(T → W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21)) = im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) → T).

The second expression is an image statement. In accordance with REV-0169, it is not an identification of T_Z with the supports group itself. Set A:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q), and let q:A→T_Z be the induced surjection.

Proved conditional step. Suppose A is isomorphic to Q(8)^r. The quotient Hodge structure A/ker(q) has only Hodge bidegree (-8,-8): the Hodge filtration on Q(8)^r has a single nontrivial jump, and the quotient filtration has the same property. If s is the rational dimension of A/ker(q), then A/ker(q) is isomorphic to Q(8)^s. Since A/ker(q) is isomorphic to im(q)=T_Z, this proves that a finite Tate decomposition of A is sufficient for the assigned conclusion. This argument uses neither a Gysin map nor a closed-embedding assertion.

Undischarged exact-target step. The verified interface ATT-0120, including CLM-0120-7 and both confirmation reviews REV-0169 and REV-0170, explicitly supplies no Tate computation of A or T_Z and no geometric map from the cohomology of the ordered model Z whose image is known to equal T_Z. Consequently the antecedent A≅Q(8)^r is not established. Replacing it by the assertion that T itself is Tate would be circular with the campaign target and is not used.

Counterexample audit. The packet's standalone-Z and constant-family non-Tate constructions do not prove that any such class has nonzero image in T_Z. They therefore do not satisfy the exact disproof clause. No verified non-Tate subquotient of the named T_Z is presently exhibited.

Failed-route audit. The argument does not use vcd-only vanishing, undecorated top-weight graph-complex reasoning, point counting without parity separation, or the forgetful-map/local-system renaming route. It also does not treat Y as a regular immersion, infer Tate cohomology from rational S_6-representations, or transfer non-Tateness from an atlas or family base to the target without proving survival.

claims.statement: For A:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q), the verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE supplies a morphism A→T whose image is exactly the named subquotient T_Z.
If A is a finite direct sum of Q(8), then its image T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8).
Unconditionally, the named T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8).

failed_approaches_addressed.subject: No Gysin or regular-immersion structure is inferred for Y.
No Tate conclusion is inferred from rationality of S_6-representations.
No standalone-Z or family-base class is declared to survive in T_Z without a proved nonzero target image.

gap_markers.description: No verified input proves that W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) is Tate, nor is there an unconditional direct computation of its image T_Z. The proved implication CLM-0123-2 is therefore only conditional and does not establish the exact theorem.

ingest_normalizations.reason: This is a target-interface contract label, not a global claim or adjudicated finding. It supplied no mathematical evidence and is retained only in this normalization record.

summary: The verified interface gives a surjection from the weight-minus-sixteen Borel–Moore group of the reduced image closure Y onto T_Z. An elementary conditional lemma shows that a Tate source would force T_Z to be a finite sum of Q(8). However, neither ATT-0120 nor its two confirmations proves that source Tate, and no verified argument computes the target image directly. No non-Tate class is proved to survive in T_Z. Thus the exact theorem is not proved or disproved.

target_interface_reference.survival_or_tate_argument: If the verified source W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) were Q(8)^r, its quotient image T_Z would be Q(8)^s. No verified artifact establishes that antecedent or a different unconditional Tate computation, and no non-Tate source class is proved to have nonzero image in T_Z; hence the exact theorem remains unresolved.
target_interface_reference.target_map_use: The Borel–Moore localization image gives a surjection W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q)→T_Z. The argument uses only this image map and never identifies T_Z with the supports group.
target_interface_reference.target_subquotient: T_Z:=ker(r_T), equivalently im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q)→T), where Y is the reduced closure of the verified classifying image.

excluded_claims: No assertion is made about assembly of the complementary target terms.
Non-Tate cohomology of an atlas, family base, product model, or standalone Z is not treated as an exact-target counterexample.
No equality between T_Z and the supports group itself is asserted.
No Gysin, regular-immersion, lci, support-exhaustion, or nonvanishing assertion is made.
theorem_scope.included_object: The named ATT-0120 kernel/image subquotient T_Z inside W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q).

theorem_statement: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.
